# A reversed loop whose destination is offset from the index (a[i+1], not
# a[i]) is a genuine loop-carried dependence: reversing it, rather than the
# no-dependence case in reverse_no_dependence.txt, is exactly why TSVC_2
# tests this shape. It must be left alone regardless of direction.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ShiftReverse(a, b []float32) {
	for i := len(a) - 2; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i+1] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
